name: Choose Your Own Valentine!
source:
Kamiyah and Valda have been adventuring together for a long time. They've fought through dungeons, they've studied with dragons. There's one thing they've never done: Kiss.

Tonight, the will is there. The tavern is there. The lights are low. Unfortunately, a gang of Sanguine Vipers is there, too. What choices will they make to reach their final kissy, kissy destination?

More importantly, what choices will you make? Because you can send your own version of this story to that special someone.

[From [url=https://alternativewonders.itch.io/choose-your-own-valentine]itch.io[/url]]
